segments.name: Retail Netherlands
segments.description: Serves private individuals, business banking clients and private banking clients in the Netherlands with daily banking, lending, savings, investments and insurance.
segments.evidence: The main products and services offered are daily banking, lending, savings, investments and insurance.

segments.name: Retail Belgium
segments.description: Serves private individuals, business banking and private banking clients in Belgium and Luxembourg with products similar to those in the Netherlands.
segments.evidence: Income from products and services provided to private individuals, business banking clients and private banking clients in Belgium and Luxembourg.

segments.name: Retail Germany
segments.description: Serves private individuals, business banking and private banking clients in Germany with the same retail products offered in the Netherlands.
segments.evidence: Income from products and services provided to private individuals, business banking clients and private banking clients in Germany.

segments.name: Retail Other
segments.description: Serves private individuals, business banking and private banking clients in the other retail countries.
segments.evidence: Income from products and services provided to private individuals, business banking clients and private banking clients in the other retail countries.

segments.name: Wholesale Banking
segments.description: Serves large corporates, multinationals and institutional clients with lending, payments and cash management, trade finance, financial markets and treasury.
segments.evidence: Income from wholesale banking activities, of which the main products are lending, payments & cash management, working capital solutions, trade finance, financial markets, corporate finance and treasury.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay ING for banking products and services: savings accounts, payments, credit cards, mortgages, unsecured lending, investment solutions and insurance, plus fees, commissions and trading income.
revenueModel.evidence: ING offers a broad range of banking products and services for private individuals, including savings accounts, payments, credit cards, mortgages, unsecured lending, investment solutions and insurance products.
